# requirements-mossrt.txt — .venv-mossrt for the MOSS-TTS-Realtime NATIVE
# sidecar (upstream fast_api.py run from server/adapters/tts/moss_tts_realtime/
# sidecar/third_party/MOSS-TTS/moss_tts_realtime). Pins follow the upstream
# pyproject torch-runtime extra (transformers 5.0 conflicts with .venv's 4.57
# and .venv-vllm — hence its own venv). +cu128 torch wheels come from the
# pytorch index (or the box wheelhouse); plain PyPI torch works too if the
# CUDA minor differs.
# Build: scripts/build_venv_mossrt.sh
--extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128
torch==2.9.1
torchaudio==2.9.1
# fast_api.py loads the ref-audio prompt via torchcodec (torchaudio's
# load_with_torchcodec) — REQUIRED or every start_turn errors "TorchCodec is
# required" → empty audio. 0.8.x pairs with torch 2.9; needs the vendored
# FFmpeg .so on LD_LIBRARY_PATH (sidecars.py injects it for this provider).
torchcodec==0.8.1
transformers==5.0.0
safetensors==0.6.2
numpy==2.1.0
einops==0.8.1
scipy==1.16.2
librosa==0.11.0
tiktoken==0.12.0
soxr==0.5.0
orjson==3.11.4
accelerate
# sidecar server
fastapi
uvicorn
pydantic
